notes: τῶν ἀζύμων was analysed against rule 102 and against this chapter's own τῆς βασιλικῆς at 12.20: the article was left unrepresented and the supplied generic noun bread kept with the substantival adjective. Rule 17's generic-noun clause is scoped in terms to anarthrous Greek, and where a Greek article governs the phrase rules 49 and 102 give it the supplied nominal — with or without a written determiner, as οἱ ἡμέτεροι -> our people shows — together with the genitive's case preposition, as REV.11.15's τοῦ κυρίου -> the kingdom of does. τῶν now takes the discontinuous of … bread headed on bread; ἀζύμων keeps a bare unleavened.
